$Word.Visible = $false

# Create a new document
$Doc = $Word.Documents.Add()

# Add title

$Title.Text = "Q3 Summary"
$Title.ParagraphFormat.LineSpacing = 20
$Title.Font.Size = 26
$Title.Font.Bold = $true

# Move cursor after title
$Selection = $Word.Selection
$Selection.MoveRight([Microsoft.Office.Interop.Word.WdUnits]::wdParagraph, 1)

# Add bullet point
$Bullet = $Selection.Range()
$Bullet.Text = "Revenue up 12%"
$Bullet.ParagraphFormat.OutlineLevel = 1

# Save the document
$Doc.SaveAs((Get-Location).Path + "\summary.docx", [Microsoft.Office.Interop.Word.WdSaveFormat]::wdFormatDocx)

# Close Word
$Doc.Close()
$Word.Quit()

Write-Output "Document created: summary.docx"
